description: We are a passionate team of engineers, UI/UX designers, and developers bridging space technology and human inspiration. We plan to develop AstroHeritage: Hardware & Heroes, an interactive 3D platform showcasing historic NASA spacecraft, rovers, and technologies while honoring the engineers, scientists, and coders behind them. Our goal is to make space exploration accessible, immersive, and inspiring worldwide.
summary: AstroHeritage is a transformative digital ecosystem created for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge that bridges legendary space technology and deep human inspiration. We built an immersive platform uniting over twenty advanced 3D robotic spacecraft with the brilliant engineers and heroes who brought them to life. By integrating interactive 3D hardware models, unexpected archival hero moments, historic mission timelines, and gamified STEM quizzes complete with streak counters and virtual achievements we created an addictive learning experience so engaging users will never want to delete it. Every line of code and every interactive story honors the beating hearts behind space exploration ensuring learners stay inspired and connected to the cosmos forever
details: AstroHeritage is a revolutionary digital universe built for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge that transforms how humanity connects with space exploration. We created an immersive multi-module platform that unites over twenty advanced 3D robotic spacecraft with the brilliant engineers and heroes who built them, blending detailed hardware mechanics with deeply emotional human stories. The platform features an interactive timeline of historic space milestones and a gamified STEM quiz center equipped with streak counters and virtual achievements designed to be so addictive and rewarding that users will never want to leave. Powered by React, Three.js React Three Fiber, Framer Motion, and official NASA Open APIs, our project redefines creativity by placing a beating human heart behind cold steel and robotic circuits. Our team carefully considered user engagement, seamless glassmorphic aesthetics, and emotional storytelling to ensure that learners do not just study space history but truly feel it making AstroHeritage an unforgettable journey that inspires the next generation of explorers to reach for the stars.
